terms.gloss: the store of food kept in a house; provisions
evidence: Plaut. Capt. 920: dīcam ut sibi penum alium adōrnet
Cic. N. D. 2.68: est enim omne, quō vēscuntur hominēs, penus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Also neuter, penus, penoris and penum. It gives cella penāria, the pantry, and the Penātēs.

phrases.latin: dīcam ut sibi penum alium adōrnet, sīquidem sēsē ūtī volet
phrases.english: I’ll tell him to lay in a second stock of food, if he means to have any for himself

sources: Lewis & Short: penus
